Name: Claire English Wedding Dress
Author: Elaho
TagLine: Changes Claire’s wedding outfit to incorporate traditional English (Anglo-Saxon) wedding attire.
Description:
**UPDATE: V.1.1.3 [or higher] is now compatible with Poltergeister's Seasonal Outfit Mods (SVE, SVE Cuter, and Seasonal Cute)**

This mod changes Claire’s wedding outfit to incorporate traditional English (Anglo-Saxon) wedding attire. Her wedding dress is styled after the high medieval period in England (13th and 14th centuries) and includes features such as:

-       High-collared tunic dress with corset (__Kirtle__)
-       Traditional woven flower crown (depending on the season)
-       Sheer white veil (depending on the season)
-       Tight, long-sleeve tunic that covers the back of the hands
-       Bell-shaped tunic sleeves (__Bliaut__) with hood and silver circlet (depending on the season)
-       Traditional English lace veil (depending on the season)
-       Beautifully ornate silver belt (__Girdle__)

A meek yet steadfast people, the English are very connected to their past, tracing their long, complex history through centuries and centuries of rich, vibrant traditions. As a character, Claire is deeply connected to history. She seems to radiate mature wisdom and sincere appreciation for things that came before her, such as her love of old film, traditional dance (ballet), and traditional food (such as tea, bruschetta, and Butterfish).

Considering this, plus Claire’s meek yet unwavering personality, as well as her fair features, I thought giving Claire an English (Anglo-Saxon) background would suit her character really well. And I think Claire, being the classy, elegant, and mature woman she is, would want to share her love of tradition with you on your special day together.

__“May your beautiful marriage be full of everlasting joy. Congratulations. Wishing you peace, joy, and happiness today and forever.”__
------------------------------------
*PLEASE NOTE:

**UPDATE: V.1.1.3 is now compatible with Poltergeister's Seasonal Outfit Mods (SVE, SVE Cuter, and Seasonal Cute). No action needed.**

This mod will NOT work with other wedding outfit mods that include Claire. If you want this mod to be compatible with other sprite editing mods, you'll need to either delete Claire's wedding version in those mods or only have this one installed. Having two different mods that change Claire's wedding appearance will not work together and may cause the game to crash.*

Compatibility with other outfit mods will be added in a future update.
-----------------------------------
**THIS MOD IS NOW AVAILABLE ON CURSEFORGE AND MODDROP!** NexusMods, CurseForge, and ModDrop are the only websites I've uploaded this Mod to. If you see this mod on any other websites than the ones listed, it has been uploaded by someone else without my permission. Please only upload this Mod from Nexus, Curseforge, or ModDrop :) Thank you!
